items.q: What should you remember about **2012 elbow for girls**?
items.a: **anxiety, depression, self-harm, ER visits, and hospital admissions all inflect** sharply ~2012; boys rise earlier (~2009) and more gradually; international data replicate the pattern (not just Gen Z "talking more").

items.q: What should you remember about **Sensitive period mismatch**?
items.a: **puberty opens plasticity for identity, relationships, and social** learning; we hand kids pocket internet + algorithmic extremity exactly when parental control drops (middle school).

items.q: What should you remember about **No social media safe for minors**?
items.a: **prestige = likes/followers → brand managers,** not play; "running the gauntlet" shock-content challenges; trauma images occupy neural real estate permanently.

items.q: What should you remember about **Phone-free school is non-negotiable**?
items.a: **"keep in pocket" = constant** conflict; Yondr pouches/lockers; TikTok in class teaches wrong dopamine loops, not math.

items.q: What should you remember about **Restore adventure, not just restrictions**?
items.a: Fortnite memories ≠ real-world fort-building; **dynamic subordination groups** (sports, drill, dance) teach hierarchy without toxicity; boredom helps kids discover preferences.

items.q: What should you remember about **casino analogy social media**?
items.a: **platforms extract attention like casinos; inconceivable we'd** lease childhood to a brothel but we leased it to TikTok/Instagram/Snapchat under Section 230.

items.q: What should you remember about **Coordination solves the lonely kid problem**?
items.a: **one family acting alone imposes** cost; simultaneous norm shifts (Let Grow, phone-free schools) break the trap.
